description: Wait up to two minutes and return as soon as an individual answer is saved, including answers received while an agent was reconnecting and while the form remains in progress. The wait ends when this call returns; nothing keeps watching afterward. Pass the returned nextSince as since to continue without repeating answers; the HTTP bridge also exposes an SSE stream endpoint.

since.description: ISO timestamp cursor from the last response the agent processed.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds, capped at 120000.

name: watch_ask
title: Watch Superforms Ask
